metadata.description: A disciplined AI pair-programming companion for Claude Code: one steering document plus a small portable core, so Claude queues work, decides with brutal-honest recommendations against a requirements ledger, and keeps your code clean — automatically, with almost no setup.

plugins.name: companion
plugins.description: How Claude works on your project, in one place. A steering document (in context automatically at session start, and on demand any time) defines how Claude turns your requests into a live task queue, decides with brutally honest multiple-choice recommendations that name what each option would change, runs autonomously when you step away, and keeps code clean as it changes it. A portable core backs it — its own task-queue CLI (a self-owned queue that works even where Claude's native task tools are switched off), also reachable via an MCP server for any MCP-capable client, an advisory credential-shape scanner, cross-session resume, and an animated status line. Most of it is advisory — traded deliberately for portability beyond Claude Code — except guaranteed context delivery and a block on proceeding past an unanswered decision under autopilot, kept as Claude-Code-only guarantees. Everything else (wireframe-first, outcome-checks, present-parked-first) is steering, not machinery.
